title: Anthropic says your leaked Claude chats are working as intended

content_html:
Type the right query into Google over the weekend and you could read strangers’ conversations with Claude. Some held medical records. Some held company files and children’s phone numbers.

The chats were not hacked or leaked in any technical sense. Users had shared them through a Claude feature built for that. Search engines then indexed the pages like any other public link.

Anthropic’s position is that nothing failed. The system, it says, is working as intended.

How it surfaced

A Reddit user flagged it on Saturday. The search operator “site:claude.ai/share” returned a long list of shared Claude chats. 404 Media first reported it on Monday, and the rest of the tech press followed within hours.

Claude conversations are private by default. Only shared ones were affected. Sharing creates a snapshot of the chat at its own public web address, meant for a colleague or a small group.

The problem is what “public” turned out to mean. A simple “noindex” tag tells search engines to leave a page out of results. It does not appear Anthropic used one.

What was in them

The exposed material was not trivial. Futurism reviewed the results through Google. It found a detailed medical report on a named patient, clinical-trial results listing patient names, and documents holding the names and phone numbers of primary-school-aged children.

Other cases were worse for being ordinary. Reddit users cited a person building a crypto wallet who exposed its keys. Another was a lawyer asking Claude whether they had to self-report a breach of professional conduct.

Claude Artifacts were caught in the same net. These are the interactive apps and documents people build in the tool. Internal dashboards and project plans with client data turned up alongside the chats.

Anthropic’s answer

Asked what happened, Anthropic did not describe a fix. It described a design.

“We give people control over sharing their Claude conversations publicly, and in keeping with our privacy principles, we do not share chat directories or sitemaps with search engines like Google,” spokeswoman Amie Rotherham told TechCrunch.

“These shareable links are not guessable or discoverable unless people choose to share them themselves. When someone shares a conversation, they are making that content publicly accessible.”

The company added that links only reach search results once a user posts them somewhere a crawler can see. In effect, it placed the responsibility with the people who pressed share.

The comparison that hurts

That defence runs into an obvious counter-example. Google Docs offers a near-identical share feature. Those documents do not end up searchable on Google.

The difference is the missing instruction to search engines. Google’s spokesperson Ned Adriance told TechCrunch that site owners hold the crawl and index controls, and that Google respects them. The choice not to use them sat with Anthropic.

Underneath is a gap between two definitions of consent. Anthropic is technically right that sharing makes content public. The harder question is whether the person sharing a patient file understood they were publishing it to the open web.

It has happened before, at every lab

This is not new, which is what makes it striking. Forbes reported almost the same thing last September. Google had indexed just under 600 Claude conversations before removing them, and Anthropic said then it had blocked crawlers.

OpenAI walked into it too. Last year 404 Media found nearly 100,000 shared ChatGPT conversations searchable on Google, and OpenAI pulled the feature. Elon Musk’s Grok was caught the same way.

Anthropic has had a run of data-exposure stories this year. Researchers showed Claude Cowork could break out of its sandbox and read credentials on a Mac. Grok Build was found uploading whole code repositories. Those were bugs. This was the product working correctly.

What to actually do

Anthropic appears to have addressed the indexing. As of Monday afternoon the search technique returned nothing. Anyone already holding an old link can still reach it, though, and content can linger in caches and third-party archives.

Users can review what they have shared under Settings, then Privacy, then Shared Chats, and revoke any link there.

The wider lesson sits above any one setting. Chatbots now absorb the role of confidant for work, health and legal worries, so the share button carries far more than a link. Anthropic’s own tightening privacy regime shows it knows the stakes.

Tools like credential systems that never expose the underlying data show what careful handling looks like. A feature that quietly publishes a medical file is the opposite, and calling it intended does not make it safe. The pattern of AI security failures this year keeps pointing at one root: systems that treat access as consent.

周末在谷歌中输入正确的查询，你就可以阅读陌生人与克劳德的对话。 有些人持有医疗记录。 有些人持有公司文件和孩子的电话号码。

从任何技术意义上讲，这些聊天记录都没有被黑客入侵或泄露。 用户通过克劳德为此构建的功能分享了它们。 然后，搜索引擎像任何其他公共链接一样对页面建立索引。

周六，一名 Reddit 用户举报了这一事件。 搜索操作符“site:claude.ai/share”返回了一长串共享的 Claude 聊天记录。 404 Media 在周一首先报道了这一消息，其他科技媒体在几小时内也纷纷跟进。

默认情况下，克劳德的对话是私人的。 只有共享的受到影响。 共享会在其自己的公共网址上创建聊天快照，供同事或小组使用。

问题在于“公共”到底意味着什么。 一个简单的“noindex”标签告诉搜索引擎将某个页面排除在结果之外。 Anthropic 似乎没有使用过它。

暴露的材料并非微不足道。 未来主义通过谷歌查看了结果。 它发现了一份关于一名指定患者的详细医疗报告、列出患者姓名的临床试验结果以及包含小学学龄儿童姓名和电话号码的文件。

其他情况则因普通而更糟糕。 Reddit 用户引用了一名构建加密钱包的人的话说，该人泄露了其密钥。 另一个是律师询问克劳德他们是否必须自我报告违反职业行为的行为。

克洛德神器也被困在同一张网里。 这些是人们在该工具中构建的交互式应用程序和文档。 内部仪表板和包含客户数据的项目计划与聊天一起出现。

人类的回答

当被问及发生了什么时，Anthropic 没有描述解决方案。 它描述了一种设计。

“我们让人们可以控制公开分享克劳德的对话，并且为了遵守我们的隐私原则，我们不会与 Google 等搜索引擎共享聊天目录或站点地图，”发言人 Amie Rotherham 告诉 TechCrunch。

“除非人们选择自己分享，否则这些可分享的链接是不可猜测或发现的。 当有人分享对话时，他们就将该内容公开。”

该公司补充说，只有当用户将链接发布到爬虫可以看到的地方时，链接才会到达搜索结果。 实际上，它把责任归咎于那些要求分享的人。

比较让人心痛

这种辩护遇到了一个明显的反例。 Google Docs 提供了几乎相同的共享功能。 这些文件最终无法在谷歌上搜索到。

不同之处在于缺少对搜索引擎的指令。 谷歌发言人内德·阿德里安斯 (Ned Adriance) 告诉 TechCrunch，网站所有者拥有抓取和索引控制权，谷歌尊重他们。 Anthropic 决定不使用它们。

下面是同意的两种定义之间的差距。 从技术上讲，人择是正确的，即共享使内容公开。 更难的问题是共享患者文件的人是否明白他们正在将其发布到开放网络上。

这种事以前在每个实验室都发生过

这并不新鲜，但这正是它引人注目的原因。 《福布斯》去年九月也报道了几乎同样的事情。 在删除之前，谷歌已经将克劳德的近 600 条对话编入索引，Anthropic 表示随后它已经屏蔽了爬虫。

OpenAI也涉足其中。 去年，404 Media 发现近 100,000 个共享的 ChatGPT 对话可在 Google 上搜索，OpenAI 取消了该功能。 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 Grok 也以同样的方式陷入困境。

Anthropic 今年发生了一系列数据曝光事件。 研究人员表明 Claude Cowork 可以突破沙箱并在 Mac 上读取凭据。 Grok Build 被发现上传整个代码存储库。 这些都是错误。 这是产品正常工作的情况。

实际做什么

Anthropic 似乎已经解决了索引问题。 截至周一下午，搜索技术没有返回任何结果。 不过，任何已经持有旧链接的人仍然可以访问它，并且内容可以保留在缓存和第三方档案中。

用户可以在“设置”、“隐私”、“共享聊天”下查看他们共享的内容，并撤销那里的任何链接。

更广泛的教训高于任何一种环境。 聊天机器人现在承担着工作、健康和法律问题知己的角色，因此分享按钮所承载的不仅仅是一个链接。 Anthropic 自身收紧的隐私制度表明它知道其中的利害关系。

像凭证系统这样从不暴露底层数据的工具显示了谨慎处理的样子。 悄悄发布医疗文件的功能则相反，称其为有意为之并不意味着它是安全的。 今年人工智能安全失败的模式始终指向一个根源：将访问视为同意的系统。
